notes.title: Death Dream 0.1.0 ( Global Update! )
notes.notes:
The update is called "Voxel World" because we changed the game style to a voxel world, a list of what we've done: 

 New Style 
 New graphics 
 New build Mechanics 
 New Player controller 
 New User Interface 
 New Music 
 New Sounds 
 New Procedural Generation
 New 70 blocks
 New 4 mobs


and much more ! to all those who bought the game: Come back, you will not regret ;), to those who just learned about this game: welcome ! Here you will have an unusual experience, surviving and fighting off mobs on scary gloomy nights, building beautiful buildings, drinking tea to survive!
